# Simplicity.IO

> Small Android apps by one developer. Contact: simplicity.io.dev@outlook.com

## Apps

- [Mainline Module Info](https://simplicity-io.github.io/mainline-module-info/) ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.trainspotting)): shows which Google Play system (Mainline) modules a device runs and tracks their updates. Android 10+ (API 29). Module history is stored on-device.
- Linux Terminal Helper ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.simplicity.toybox)): sets up and launches Android's built-in Linux Terminal. Android 15+ (API 35), needs virtualization support.
